description: This Figshare collection provides global anthropogenic heat flux grids for 1970, 2015 and 2050. The own collection API lists four image products: a coarse series at 2.5 arc-minute resolution and separate 30 arc-second grids for each of the three years. They can be used as urban waste-heat forcing in climate or building-environment simulations, or to compare broad future heat exposure scenarios. The 2050 grid is a projection, not an observation; results depend on the article's allocation method and assumptions about future activity. Grid resolution and year need explicit selection before joining it to population, land-cover or energy inputs. All 4 member item(s) state CC0 in the Figshare article API; the collection DataCite registration says CC BY 4.0. I read the descriptor and own collection metadata without opening the raster files or checking cell values. No exact catalogue record was identified. A related but distinct G1 draft covers earlier nighttime-light-based heat estimates; their methods and years should be compared before combining grids.
